title: Cottage at West End/Vandy/Hillsboro
description:
Enjoy this private, renovated and beautifully decorated, bungalow cottage apartment, right in the heart of Nashville, TN.  This is a private apartment inside a large historic home. Walk to coffee shops, trendy shopping, restaurants and Centennial Park.  Within minutes of Vandy, Belmont, Hillsboro Village,  and downtown.

The space
This is a gorgeous, completely renovated, private apartment inside a large, historic cottage!  Complete with original hardwoods, built-ins and a cozy porch swing, you can walk to Centennial Park, Starbucks, drug stores, restaurants and shops.  Convenient, short bike ride to Vandy and Belmont.  Cozy, trendy furnishings and a full kitchen!  Easy parking and super convenient!

Guest access
Free parking is available right in front of the cottage. We are located in a safe and beautiful community. Uber/Lyft are great options for getting around town. Guests have a beautiful front porch swing overlooking a lush front yard and city park.  Guests can also use any of the washer/dryer units in the common basement area.

Other things to note
This is a large, one bedroom apartment located in a historic home.  You have a washer dryer area that is in a shared, common area in the basement of the home.  A queen, sleeper sofa is also in the living area if needed. A twin roll away is also available.
